summary.content:
Today's selection covers 51 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 33 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: How Trump Drove a Wedge Between Florida Republicans Over A.I.
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Stryker attack wiped tens of thousands of devices, no malware needed
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from NY Times Tech, The Verge, TechCrunch, BleepingComputer, BBC Technology and others
• **Fresh Content**: 31 articles published in the last 24 hours
